subject: Trusted Types report-only lines fail existing e2e console guards on WebKit (ink, notebooks, cards scratch, qbank)
body: With the current shared tip (914a5ed/8d234dd), WebKit iPad/phone e2e for ink-sync, notebooks, cards scratch ink and qbank fail their zero-console-error guards on '[Report Only] This requires a TrustedHTML/TrustedScriptURL value … require-trusted-types-for script' (dozens per page), and shell's offline test fails on 'Failed to load resource … /api/csp-report' while offline. Not S18 code (reproduced on specs S18 doesn't touch). Either a default TT policy, or the console guards (fixtures.ts) ignoring [Report Only] lines, and the csp-report beacon skipped when navigator.onLine is false.
